description: SHA-level trailer contract for #1221. Path presence is a heuristic only. trailer_safe SHAs may receive a well-formed Ported-from trailer after semantic spot-check. do_not_trailer SHAs must remain Attention even at high path presence; do not add or reformat a trailer to silence them. This list does not expand the path whitelist.
